QA Automation assignment — Part 3 (API Testing).

## What this collection does
- **Folder 1 — Spec contract:** tests the assignment's `POST /api/v1/auth/login` (phone_number + otp_code): 1 positive + 5 negative/robustness cases. Each request asserts **status code**, **body/schema**, **error message** and **response time**. `{{base_url}}` is an environment variable so it runs against any conforming server or a Postman mock.
- **Folder 2 — Live backend:** real requests against the actual Enatega backend (`aws-server-v2.enatega.com`, GraphQL). These EXECUTE live and assert on real responses (health, 404 on the REST route, auth negatives). This is what the app under test really uses.

## How to run
Postman: import this + the environment, pick the env, hit **Run**. 
Newman: `newman run Enatega-Auth-Login.postman_collection.json -e Enatega-Auth.postman_environment.json -r htmlextra`
